reasons: The Datadog metric system.load.15 is the 15-minute system load average, which OTel hostmetrics covers with the gauge system.cpu.load_average.15m (same quantity, unitless, not normalized per CPU). An exact translation exists, so MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING is wrong.

otel_metric_definitions is empty, so the converter had no definition to check against. The correct outcome is translated, with promql {otel_metric_name="system.cpu.load_average.15m", otel_metric_type="gauge"}; the $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so it is dropped.
No rate() is applied because the metric is a gauge. Series grain (per host) matches the Datadog request, so no grain caveat is needed.
